lyrics.original: Kaze ga fuku michi de kimi to deatta
lyrics.id: Di jalan tempat angin berhembus, aku bertemu denganmu
lyrics.en: On the wind-blown path, I met you

lyrics.original: Kokoro ga takanaru no o osaikirenakute
lyrics.id: Aku tidak bisa menahan debaran di hatiku
lyrics.en: I couldn't hold back my racing heart

lyrics.original: We will find our way back home
lyrics.en: We will find our way back home
